Preview files
=============

00 through 07 are the corrected v1.0.2 presets.

wsound_ggrenadeblast89_montage.wav
  Full corrected preset montage.

wsound_ggrenadeblast89_speaker_fix_exact_AB.wav
  Exact reported windows, always old first and v1.0.2 second:
    1) Montage 7–8 s: 40 mm HEDP hard impact
    2) Montage 14–15 s: concrete impact
  Short silence separates old/new; a longer silence separates the two pairs.

wsound_ggrenadeblast89_crackle_fix_AB.wav
  Legacy v1.0.0 versus v1.0.1 comparison retained for history.

Listen at a moderate level. These WAV files are not calibrated in dB SPL.
